$comment: Single source of truth for the supported-journey matrix (issue #2750). Consumed by scripts/e2e/check-canonical-journeys.mjs (static | list | results). Human view: docs/testing/e2e-journey-matrix.md. Each canonical_ids entry names a test that MUST exist in the given Playwright project AND finish 'expected/passed' in a gate run; the id is matched as the LEADING token of a title segment (describe or test, after any [role:x] tag), so CC1 can never be satisfied by CC1b. Ids must stay alphanumeric. T15_ENABLED coupling (listing-lifecycle.canonical.ts): flipping it to false de-registers T15, which fails the list phase; a legitimate descope must remove the T15 entry below in the SAME change, and the static phase refuses a matrix that lists T15 while the flag is false.

harness.notes: Build-sha provenance + real fixture content probe; fails the whole run if the served build is stale.
Positive control for the console + pageerror guard: declares and provokes one expected pageerror and one expected console.error; fails if either listener is unwired.

rows.notes: City root settles area-first, Direction writes node=, bounded browse excludes other Directions, exactly one shell mounts; T24 proves Back from a Rent listing detail restores the rendered Rent leaf (cards, pressed control, summary, breadcrumb). #2860: T10b loads the anon legacy deep links (unknown groupId, explicit area-first root, Udupi areaKey=) and asserts one non-blank, ungated, guard-clean surface (arms A/B/C mutation-proven; the surface-identity rows replace stale legacy oracles pending owner decisions D2/D4); T25 asserts that a legacy area-first areaKey= deep link (Udupi Manipal) mounts exactly one areas shell (mutation NOT_PROVEN; D4 pending) and shows a Manipal status-pill count >= 4 (mutation-proven), guard-clean; markers RETAIN under D9 (markers fetch depends on live map zoom), listing cards RETAIN under D8. #2829: T26 keeps Discover mounted (in-app PUSHes; window stamp + a nonce on the Discover-owned wrapper, shown to fail after reload) across direction -> RR Nagar leaf -> Apartments chip -> Back -> leaf re-entry, and asserts the stale-copy readers (useDiscoverPageState.filters: the leaf's Apartments chip unpressed, and the unfiltered card title set incl. the non-apartment fixture title) with a URL-only type= control (U1), and guards the F2 re-entry bounce (the leaf must open after Back); T24 cannot cover this because /listing unmounts Discover.

Canonical node= renders the real school shell with a real count and seeded school names. #2860: T7b proves a stale school-first groupId is dropped on school select in one atomic write (the URL never holds schoolId with groupId) and never resurrected by Change school (all mutation-proven). Its marker-scope checks are a conditional guard only: no pre-select markers traffic was observed, so they carry no mutation credit (2205-16r NOT_PROVEN).

region + maxKm renders real agri destination data; T8b walks corridor card, distance chip 25->50, town drill-in, the listing peek and Back from the listing detail restoring the peek on the far fixture town; legacy group=DIR:BAND rewrites to the same result set. #2860: T8b adds the exact destKey/Level-3 areaKey, display-name header, cold destKey load and locality close; T9 adds the legacy locality=<area_key> migration; T8c proves the anon peek withholds the price behind a sign-in affordance.
Anon teaser and detail gating (T10/T11) plus the authed relaxation (T12) on top of node browse.
Commercial + Shop narrowing; list and marker membership agree (C13/C16/C17, #2434).

rows.journey: Residential create -> submit -> approve -> LIVE -> buyer Discover membership
rows.notes: T13/T14/T15 prove create, approve and anon detail; T15b proves Discover MEMBERSHIP of the approved listing in its area node (falsifiable: T14 records the id ABSENT from the exhaustive city set while PENDING_REVIEW; a Malpe listing is absent from the Manipal node set). T15_ENABLED coupling applies to T15.
Broker creates three Commercial listings, admin approves, buyer finds them under Commercial + Shop, anon sees the gated teaser.

T1/T2/T3 prove per-role sign-in, a Discover returnTo round trip and the typed-create route; T2b proves return-to onto a gated NON-Discover route (/my-bookings -> /auth -> back, unlocked); T1c proves sign-out ends the session across reloads on a dedicated local-only identity, from a protected route (/my-bookings -> /discover) and, since #2860, from the public homepage (returnTo=/ lands exactly on '/', signed-in header there, sign-out stays on '/', reload stays signed out) (localAuthOnly: required in the local gate, absent by design from the ENVIRONMENT_GATED hosted collection, where the checker is told the run is hosted via E2E_AUTH_MODE=hosted).
Anon sees real teaser content and an honest image gate; an authed user sees the gate relax.

rows.journey: Booking buyer -> My Bookings -> Broker Bookings
rows.notes: T16 anon never books; T17 authed POST succeeds and the row appears on /my-bookings; T17b proves the owning broker sees the SAME booking id on /broker/bookings (the run's broker is made owner of the booked fixture listing by scripts/e2e/auth-stack/create-users.sh).
Coincident markers fan apart and stay reachable; the mobile preview sheet never occludes the usable map.

RQ1 (user submits on the zero-result Bangalore/Avalahalli surface, real POST, success state) and RQ2 (admin lists the same request by id, contact masked). Both flags are enabled in the canonical TEST STACK ONLY (scripts/run-e2e-gate.sh); production defaults stay false (FC-14 guards this).
T21: save a fixture listing from a Discover card, survives reload, listed on /saved-homes by id, unsave removes it (also after reload).
T13 proves create through the real form; T22 edits one field (description) on a DRAFT the test creates, saves through the real edit form, and reads it back after reload and from the server.

rows.journey: Agricultural create -> submit -> approve -> LIVE -> agri discovery
rows.notes: T8/T9 prove agri discovery over seeded data; AG1 (created via the real agri form; closed submit gate proven in UI; photos + confirmed pin/locality arranged via the real product endpoints; page reload hydrates ?draftId=<id> and broker submits for review through the real UI button -> agricultural-submitted-panel), AG2 (admin approve), AG3 (approved parcel is in the SW agri corridor: total +1, listed by id, rendered).
T5/T6 prove node browse under one intent; T23 proves Buy -> Rent changes the result set by id on RR Nagar and the intent survives a List -> Map -> List switch (mobile shell).
